name: SIQ - FC Runway
description: Fashion runway-inspired featured collection where products appear in an alternating left-right zigzag layout like models walking a catwalk. Each product row features a large image on one side with editorial product details on the other, connected by an elegant center timeline with animated dots. Includes staggered scroll-triggered entrance animations, hover image zoom, sale badges, vendor tags, and a dramatic gradient divider line. Configurable image sizes, layout direction, animation intensity, typography, and full color control. Perfect for fashion, luxury, and editorial brands.
author: SectionIQ
